title: Sunlit Steps
lyrics: Morning opens bright and warm. We smile, dance, and hope beneath the sunrise.

title: Quiet Harbor
lyrics: A quiet harbor holds a steady light. Calm water carries an ordinary song.

title: Paper Moon
lyrics: The room feels empty since you are gone. Lonely tears fall beside a broken paper moon.

title: Storm Signal
lyrics: Sudden lightning! I tremble in the dark while danger circles the door.
